decisions.reason: The same-message drawing-format change is already fully represented by the existing MODIFY, including replacement of DXF with the required PDF, DWG, and native SolidWorks drawing format.
The PDF-first confirmation sequence is already established by its same-message INTRODUCE and is not further changed by the 3D model format decision.
The dimension instructions are separately and completely represented by same-message Events; the 3D model file-package change does not alter them.
Changing final model file formats does not alter the required sliding-mandrel keyway geometry.
The source decision concerns deliverable formats and does not resolve or change the thread-relief groove or its unresolved width.
The SolidWorks and STEP deliverable decision does not change the bushing arrangement, fit, motion, or retention requirements.
The source decision changes file-package formats only and leaves the main-shaft keyway omission unchanged.
The requested native and exchange file formats do not change the instruction to retain the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes.
The deliverable-format change has no effect on the required 120-degree lug-hole spacing.
Providing native SolidWorks drawing files does not change the assembly-aligned drawing-numbering rule.
The source decision concerns output file formats and does not modify any part material specification.
The model file-package change does not alter the locking-thread geometry or the 65 mm bushing-space requirement.
